notes.title: Notice Regarding This Week's Story Update Schedule
notes.notes:
Players,



Thank you for playing "Boyhood's End".

Please note that due to the development team's summer break, there will be no story update this week.



The next update is scheduled for Friday, August 22nd (JST).



We apologize to everyone who has been looking forward to the update and appreciate your understanding.



We hope you continue to enjoy "Boyhood's End".

notes.title: Patch Notes & Main Story Update Announcement
notes.notes:
●Part 1 of Chapter 2 has been released.
The next update is set for December 20, and after that, there’ll be new updates for Chapter 2 every two weeks.

●DaveGames has been added and is now playable in the PC part.

●Optional features have been added and improved:
Master volume
Adjustable volume slider
Sound effects and background sounds are now grouped under "Sound Effects"

●Explanation for saving and loading

●Adjustable hacking effects during exploration

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Fixed the issue where point-and-click movement wasn't working in certain areas
- Adjusted drone control movement in the Bathing Faciliities
- Now you can stop the hacking with cancel when searching
- Improved the detection range for hackable objects

Additionally, we made adjustments to expressions and effects in a total of 24 areas.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
・Fixed some dialogue that were symbols unintentionally for English, Chinese, and Korean.
・Added screenshot function (F12 key) 
・Fixed a bug that caused an error when getting the R-code from Karellen.
・Fixed a bug that caused an error at the start of hacking while playing on Steam Deck.
・Fixed some hint texts that were symbols unintentionally for English.
・Fixed a bug of possible freeze where Geovanni gives his PC.
 
Additionally, a total of 21 texts/effects were adjusted.

notes.title: Trial version has now been released!
notes.notes:
Dear all

In conjunction with the Steam Next festival, we have released a demo version of “Boyhood's End”!
In this trial version, you can play the first part of the first chapter.
The trial version is of course free!
You can download the trial from the Store Page:
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021050
 
We welcome your thoughts and feedback on the trial version.
We have created a thread in the Community Hub, so please feel free to post your comments there.
Thank you for your continued support of "Boyhood's End".
